root_cause: The Problem Radar executive feature required more than implementation: delivery metadata, material writeback, learning replay evidence and production identity all had to be closed in one canonical lineage. Merge state alone repeatedly proved insufficient as a completion signal. A repeated CONTROL_PLANE_ADMISSION_ERROR was traced to GitHub CLI output exceeding Node execFileSync's default maxBuffer when enumerating many open pull requests; current main fixes this with maxBuffer=16*1024*1024. Reconciliation also exposed a GitHub PR auto-close race when the head branch was temporarily reset exactly to base before the obligation delta was replayed. Runner saturation was amplified by long-lived website/browser and production-readback jobs without job-level timeouts, allowing hung verification to retain hosted runners far beyond the bounded retry logic inside individual steps. Production readback workflows also accumulated obsolete main-commit verification because canonical-brand-shell readback had no concurrency guard and production-release-readback explicitly used cancel-in-progress:false. A later Required page-SEO build exposed a runtime ReferenceError because PUBLIC_UTILITY_ROUTES was imported but the absolute UTILITY_ROUTES set used by technical SEO link validation was never derived.
prevention_rule: For Problem Radar and comparable material Powerhouse work, validate delivery metadata before CI, carry Brain learning + ledger + human documentation in the same lineage, bind learning to historical replay, and prove production with provider state/context/commit_ref. Use ancestry for feature inclusion and SHA equality for exact-current-main claims. When a value/evidence invariant is tightened, migrate every historical fixture that encoded the old contract in the same lineage; do not weaken the production guard to satisfy stale tests. Learning canonicalization only accepts replay paths in the sanctioned regression namespace; source-local test files may be supporting evidence but not historical_replay entries. GitHub control-plane collectors that may return large JSON must set an explicit bounded maxBuffer and summarize errors instead of dumping full API payloads. During same-PR reconciliation, never leave the PR head equal to base as an intermediate externally visible state; if unavoidable, immediately verify/reopen the same PR after replaying the delta. Long-running browser/readback jobs must have job-level timeout-minutes in addition to bounded internal retries, so a stuck child process cannot leak runner capacity indefinitely. Do not use reopen/close churn as a primary runner-capacity recovery strategy; prevention belongs in bounded job timeouts and workflow-level supersession before jobs get stuck. Production readback is current-state verification, so newer main pushes supersede older unfinished readbacks: use single-flight concurrency with cancel-in-progress:true. When a concurrency invariant intentionally changes, migrate every regression that encodes the old value in the same lineage; never leave stale tests to veto the new canonical contract. Imported canonical route contracts must be transformed into the exact runtime representation before use, and a regression must exercise/inspect that derivation rather than only asserting the import exists.
failed_approaches: Treating product implementation as sufficient without the required Base-SHA delivery envelope.
Treating human documentation alone as sufficient material writeback without Brain learning and activity ledger.
Creating learning invariants without the required historical replay reference.
Treating merge or preview evidence as proof of production.
Assuming a production commit had to equal the feature merge instead of proving ancestry when production had legitimately advanced.
Leaving legacy company-ledger and company-decision fixtures on the pre-Verified-Value semantics after #2786 tightened realized-value eligibility.
Using the default execFileSync maxBuffer for GitHub API responses whose open-PR payload can grow beyond the buffer.
Resetting the canonical PR branch to current main before replaying the obligation delta, allowing GitHub to auto-close the PR during the transient zero-diff state.
Relying only on step-internal retry loops while leaving the enclosing GitHub Actions job unbounded.

Reopening and re-closing an already closed PR to rely on PR-scoped concurrency cancellation did not terminate already in-progress reusable-workflow jobs; do not treat that as a reliable capacity-recovery mechanism.
Allowing multiple obsolete main-commit production readbacks to remain in progress concurrently.
A historical regression still encoded cancel-in-progress:false for production readback after the runtime contract intentionally moved to single-flight supersession.
Importing PUBLIC_UTILITY_ROUTES and asserting its presence without defining the absolute UTILITY_ROUTES runtime set consumed by technical SEO validation.
